Tame/ordinary elliptic isogeny and branch-inertia normal generation

statements.limitation: Includes cyclic cubic covers; does not cover every characteristic-two curve.

Poonen hypotheses (i), (ii), or (iii), or the stated strengthened modular hypothesis

statements.title: ST2017 proper J-large clauses with empty exceptional sets

statements.title: ST2017 affine matched-open theorem with all interior point labels
statements.limitation: Retains all original matched-open and Jacobian-largeness hypotheses.

statements.title: ST2009 exceptional-set removal with corrected quotient-level dependency
statements.limitation: The false full configuration sequence is not restored; p-primary correction terms remain.

statements.title: Mochizuki separation and Green-compatibility clauses become automatic in full prime-to-p scope

statements.title: All-prime logarithmic comparison over a henselian rank-one valuation ring
inputs: Affine-charted noetherian approximation and saturated node charts

statements.status: Refuted in all residue-characteristic-zero henselian finite-transcendence-degree cases
statements.title: Supported-scaling obstruction for nondiscrete henselian fields
inputs: B.CF6 logarithmic coordinate argument generalized to arbitrary radii
statements.limitation: The universal mixed-characteristic cases without a residue-characteristic-zero henselian coarsening remain outside this theorem.

statements.title: Complete direct dependency census and quotient repairs for the five named papers
inputs: A.CF12 fixed-prime relative exactness and boundary transport
statements.limitation: Original full mixed-group fibre inclusion is false; its full-group slimness consequence is independently unestablished here. This is a census of the disputed dependency, not a certificate for unrelated proofs.

statements.title: Complete explicit separation-condition census in Mochizuki, Wakabayashi and both virtual-curve preprints
statements.limitation: Retains all-prime divisor hypotheses, singleton-prime scope, and virtual-curve geometricity requirements; gives no unproved Hom or section-surjectivity extension.

statements.title: A positive-rank cyclic-thirteen primitive-zero cover with no supersingular factor
inputs: Exact all-point Lang-character computation over F64
statements.limitation: An explicit positive B1/B4 example and obstruction to a proposed B5 route; does not refute B5 for the base curve.

statements.title: Ordinary cubic Pryms for characteristic-two hyperelliptic 2-rank-zero curves of genus two or three
statements.limitation: An obstruction to this cubic construction only; neither a counterexample to B5 nor an assertion for genus at least four.

statements.title: Riemann-Hurwitz obstruction to uniform fibres by fixed-function postcomposition
inputs: Riemann-Hurwitz and multiplicativity of ramification indices
statements.limitation: Assumes every fibre of the initial map has ramification gcd one; does not exclude choosing a new function on the covering curve.

statements.title: Three uniformly divisible fibres with a supersingular Fermat quotient
statements.scope: Odd r>=3 with r dividing p^a+1; includes all characteristic-two cyclic-prime curves with even order of2 modulo the covering prime.
statements.limitation: Does not prove arbitrary-source B5, nor the characteristic-two cyclic7 case.
